sources.title: Measles death toll at 1,252 as 1 more child dies

quotes.text: One more child died from measles-like symptoms in the 24 hours until 8am today (31 October), taking the combined toll of suspected and laboratory-confirmed measles-related deaths in Bangladesh to 1,252.

Of the total deaths, 1,147 were suspected measles-related deaths, while 105 were confirmed through laboratory tests, according to the daily update from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

sources.title: Reuters: Bangladesh measles outbreak warns of vaccine gaps

quotes.text: In a report published in July, WHO and UNICEF estimated first-dose coverage in 2025 had fallen to 90%, while second-dose coverage was 86%, several percentage points below the 95% needed for herd immunity.

Minutes noted the proportion of children with confirmed measles cases who had not been vaccinated was “virtually unchanged between pre-campaign (82%) and post-campaign (85%) ... underscoring persistent coverage gaps”.
